sourceFile: 16. BRS-161016 GMI Report test  suspension used SUS-ARRAY of new vender CSY Tech Vina first lot 2,3 date 25.10.2024 copy_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the main Normal vs CSY Tech Vina test-lot comparison but contains incorrect vision-spot metrics and invalid measurement groupings.
issues: Vision spot NG and rates are misparsed for Normal and both test lots.
Tension D rows lose parent type; C/D side grouping is not preserved.
Header-derived measurement outcomes are artifacts and should not be final evidence.
Changed factor is too narrow as lot; it should reflect new vendor SUS-array with lots 2 and 3 as subgroups.
Decision rows are omitted from final evidence.
correctionPlan: Recalculate vision-spot outcomes from rows 31, 33, and 35 using Total NG and NG Rate.
Regroup tension results by type and side C/D, inheriting merged type values for D rows.
Remove header-only measurement outcomes or convert valid defect columns into process-defect subresults.
Revise changed factor to CSY Tech Vina new vendor SUS-array vs Normal, with lot 2 and lot 3 as test subgroups.
Add decision rows 55-58 to evidence and align judgements with the report conclusion.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but cited evidence is insufficient until corrected metrics, grouping, and decision rows are included.
